correctness.rationale: There is an independent short upper-bound and rigidity proof. For each unknown word U, projection outside supp(U) is injective on the whole code: no other word projects to zero (one-error condition), and no two other words have the same projection (two-error condition). Thus n<=2^(5-wt(U)) for every U, and for n>=6 all words have weight at most two. The zero word is impossible. If a singleton occurs, every other word avoids its coordinate; deleting that singleton and coordinate leaves at least five words in length four, all of weight at most one by the same bound, a contradiction. For the remaining weight-two words the X-condition is exactly triangle-freeness: two disjoint edges have four-point XOR, and two adjacent edges have two-point XOR covered by an unknown edge iff they form a triangle. At least six edges require maximum degree at least three; degree four forces a four-edge star; degree three leaves an independent three-neighbor set and only one other vertex, which must join all three neighbors to reach six edges. This forces K_2,3 and excludes seven. Conversely every labeled K_2,3 satisfies the X-condition. Its smaller shore can be chosen in ten ways, all one S_5 orbit, with stabilizer S_2 times S_3 of order 12. Read RESULT.md, VERIFICATION.md, the census and recorded output, and inspected artifacts/verify.py without executing it. Independent projection enumeration (`python3 /tmp/opencode/frozen_math_replay_1_2_4.py 1`) covered the remaining 5,005 six-subsets and 6,435 seven-subsets after the weight bound, giving 10 and 0 respectively. All census masks, edge lists, degree-three shores and recorded artifact hashes matched. The original larger candidate counts are binomial(31,6)=736281 and binomial(31,7)=2629575. No larger-parameter classification is inferred.

value.rationale: This parameter lies at the first genuine compaction length for this error/unknown model. In fact, n>m for m=1,2 forces zero weight by the projection bound; for m=3,4 it forces weight at most one, hence n<=m. At m=5, the six-word construction gives n>m. It is useful at this natural cutoff to know not only that the fan-out-two architecture works but that no higher- or mixed-weight architecture competes, and to have all possible optima up to wire relabeling. The restricted graph result does not answer that structural question.
